title: The model-per-role guard catches a spawn that names no model and inherits one above the role's cap
why: Incident, lane merge-runs-repo-checks, 2026-11-07 07:xx CST, relayed by the coordinator 08:25 CST: guard agent-role-model (the model-per-role check) let a test-author spawn run on Opus. The spawn named no model, so it inherited the session model. Rule roles-sonnet-is-the-ceiling caps the test-author at Sonnet.
note: The guard refuses the spawn, or sets the role's model, when a spawn names no model and the inherited model is above the role's cap. Done check: a red test on an unnamed test-author spawn from an Opus session. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). No owner question. Related debt in #1411: ready-checks-skipped-by-mcp. Lane agent-model-unnamed-spawn ([ended:lane:-agent-model-unnamed-spawn]) started 2026-11-07 08:27 CST. Closed as no defect, coordinator 08:33 CST Nov 7: the lane measured that both unnamed test-author spawns ran Haiku (resolvedModel claude-haiku-5-5 on every child event). The role pin `model: haiku` and the guard held. The Opus events were the lane's own turns. Lane archived, no PR. Coordinator 22:54 CST Nov 12 sighting: reviewers and test-authors run haiku when no model is named; the merge tool refuses a haiku fix check and a haiku round 2; reviewers ran sonnet only with a `Round N of 3` first line plus model sonnet. The roles table and the merge tool disagree. Triage 23:23 CST Nov 12: no defect, stays done. Coordinator 23:22 CST asked for a ready step: two lanes (#3083, words-probe-skips-kept-names) dropped a sonnet model field after the guard refused it on a round-1 reviewer, so the reviewer ran haiku. Haiku is the round-1 reviewer row in decision agent-model-cap (line 29), and rule roles-third-round-steps-up says round 1 uses the role's model; sonnet needs a `Round N of 3` or `Fix check` first line. A change of the round-1 model is the open conditional item (haiku round-1 reviewer, after the noise share of fail rates is measured).
